Field Label: Supratentorial stroke leading to upper limb weakness (FMA <50)
Discharged and residing within a 100 km radius of the hospital
PLUTO criteria: A minimum of 10 degrees of active range of motion with reversal of movement in any one of the mechanisms (WFE or WURD or FPS, or 2 cm on the HOC assessment)
MARS criteria: A minimum of 10 cm of active range of motion in medial/lateral movement of the arm or anterior/posterior movement of the elbow
Receiving home or in-clinic therapy for upper limb
Other conditions (Neurological/medical) contributing to upper limb impairment
Musculoskeletal complications of upper limb, such as periarthritis, shoulder subluxation, CRPS, contracture, and deformity
Pain in the upper limb limiting therapy (NPRS>5)
